evidence.note: Ran real boto3 client against core ops AND both header-signed and query-signed (presigned GET/PUT) SigV4 paths, verifying signing byte-compatibility — beyond happy-path signing checks.
Verified admin API, audit log, cross-tenant AccessDenied, bucket policy, anonymous access, and versioning via boto3/curl — good edge and error-code coverage.

Ran a 30-worker concurrency test, big multipart + ranged-GET data-integrity check, UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD edge, restart/default-seed test, and error-code checks — substantial negative/edge verification on the correctness gate.
Console verification was only a curl of /console/ returning HTML; no DOM/testid-driven interaction test despite the console being browser-graded on visible side-effects and worth half the score.

reasoning: The agent went well past anchor 5 on the correctness gate — real boto3 round-trips, both signing modes, multipart/versioning correctness, cross-tenant error codes, restart/seed, and a 30-client concurrency test. But it fell short of anchor 8 in two ways: the checks were ad-hoc one-off scripts rather than a repeatable harness used to gate milestones, and the console (half the final score) received only a 'renders' curl check with zero DOM/testid-driven side-effect verification. Strong boto3 coverage plus a console blind spot places this at a 6.
